notes: Safer updates: every download is signed by Project Moon Pi, and the game checks the signature before installing an update
Quieter updates: from this build on, Update now installs the next build by itself, with just a progress bar
The new Project Moon Pi badge, without the red swoosh, in the start-up intro, About and the installers
Careers now end with "Your career ended due to…" instead of "You have died of…"
Nobody dies any more: the fatigue-accident endings are redrawn (hospital, hay field, a bench with crutches) and the event texts are gentler
A small red helicopter on a helipad on the title picture is the way into a secret
